title: Recover an underlying quadratic order despite arbitrary comparisons at rare fixed addresses
statement: For fixed native bad-address mass epsilon, long-fibre direct K-vote labels have fibre-average error<=1/(2sqrt(K+2))+1/N+3delta_y. Short-fibre census has error<=3delta_y using N-1 comparisons, even with adaptive inconsistent bad replies. K=511 and censusN<=64 tolerate epsilon<=1/1024 and give3577*n*D_n*R total logical comparisons in the capped quadratic bootstrap.

requires: A fixed unknown bad set chosen before fresh tapes, true underlying quadratic permutation, correct good-good lexicographic comparator and exact conditional sampler on the true-prefix event.
provides: For fixed native bad-address mass epsilon, long-fibre direct K-vote labels have fibre-average error<=1/(2sqrt(K+2))+1/N+3delta_y. Short-fibre census has error<=3delta_y using N-1 comparisons, even with adaptive inconsistent bad replies. K=511 and censusN<=64 tolerate epsilon<=1/1024 and give3577*n*D_n*R total logical comparisons in the capped quadratic bootstrap.
assumptions: No moving bad set selected after future bits, no independent/per-fibre noise guarantee, no promise recognition or exact model of arbitrary corrupted rank bits. Census checks x is present. Historical missing guards stay missing.
costs: Pay actual511 votes or N-1 census comparisons, complete capped fibre collection, cube correction/interpolation, random bits and all rejected preparations. General tolerance costs polynomially in1/(1/28-3epsilon).
contract.units: epsilon and delta_y are probabilities; R is the correction repetition count, distinct from geometric gain in thermal cards; logical calls are counts.
contract.obstruction: A selected conditional fibre can be completely corrupt; robustness uses native-marginal accounting rather than pretending every fibre is clean.

body: Good-good comparisons are exact, while a fresh sampled bad endpoint perturbs the conditional Bernoulli probability by at mostdelta_y. Stochastic domination plus the Beta sample-median law gives the averaged rank bound. A complete paid short-fibre list must contain the requested x; otherwise return UNKNOWN. Its win count changes by at most the number of bad points, so at most2b good ranks plus b bad requests err. Fresh cube vertices are native-uniform at trial start, not after intermediate revelations; their marginal union bound and fresh-trial martingale majority recover the true polynomial values. Entirely bad individual fibres are allowed. The general epsilon<1/84 case pays its actual margin-dependent cutoff and voting/list costs.
